description: Research r20 (dev only, step-capped, B200 workers): r16 (calibration/research_r16/mal0_st500: r5's recipe with the cosine to 0.1x counted over 500 steps; dev at step 400 0.397 +- 0.011, final 0.364 +- 0.084) with training rollouts at temperature 1.1 (log-probs at the same temperature; the in-loop dev eval stays greedy and records score at T = 1). r16's and r19's seeds that slid after step 400 had entropy near 0.03, and r19 tc768 seed 0 slid with its truncated share flat, so this tests the entropy fall.
